model: H_(N,a) f(j)=[2f(j)-f(j-1)-f(j+1)]/a^2 on C^N, periodic indices, N>=3

limits.fixed_a: Delta tends to0 as N tends to infinity
limits.fixed_L_equals_Na: Delta tends to4*pi^2/L^2 as N tends to infinity

proof: Substitution of v_k into H gives (2-exp(2pi ik/N)-exp(-2pi ik/N))/a^2. The smallest nonzero value occurs at k=1,N-1. The limits follow from sin(x)/x ->1. The eigenvalue identities and limiting conclusion are analytic; displayed decimal samples are illustrative.
scope: One-particle finite quantum Hamiltonian toy; not Yang-Mills, not a Markov-chain inference, and no continuum gauge theory constructed.
